outcomes.name: The transition to business as usual has been refined based on pilot learnings
The transition to business as usual is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Strategic Direction & Leadership to identify what needs to change in the transition to business as usual before scaling.
Refine the transition to business as usual to Strategic Direction & Leadership based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined transition to business as usual covering Strategic Direction & Leadership ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined transition to business as usual for Strategic Direction & Leadership is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the transition to business as usual for Strategic Direction & Leadership remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the transition to business as usual affected Process & Sustainment.
Adapt the transition to business as usual relating to Process & Sustainment for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the transition to business as usual covering Process & Sustainment to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Process & Sustainment among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the transition to business as usual for Process & Sustainment.
